style: --check-border: var(--form-check-border, var(--slate-400, #94a3b8)); --check-active: var(--form-check-active, var(--accent, #2563eb)); --check-text: var(--form-check-text, var(--navy-900, #0f172a)); position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 20px;

children.style: position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border-width: 0; &:checked + label::before { border-color: var(--check-active); } &:checked + label::after { opacity: 1; } &:focus-visible + label::before { outline: 2px solid var(--check-active); outline-offset: 2px; }

position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding-left: 24px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: var(--check-text); user-select: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; &::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 4px; background-color: transparent; border: 2px solid var(--check-border); transition: all 0.2s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } &::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background-color: var(--check-active); transition: all 0.2s ease; opacity: 0; box-sizing: border-box; } &:hover::before { border-color: var(--check-active); }
